title: Home shows the supervisor's newest For-the-owner block as current, each line with what became of its tasks; earlier lines and repeats leave the card
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/attention.rs (`owner_notes`, `owner_note`, `for_owner`, `owner_lines`: the supervisor's lines for the owner behind `/api/attention`'s `supervisor.for_owner`, with `tasks` and `settled`, objectives 064 and 070) and web/src/home.ts (`latestNotes`, Home's "From the supervisor" card; `allNotes`, the full list).

The problem, as the owner reads Home after 070 went live (lead-mac, sync/queue.md 09:50; sync/home-2026-11-12-0945.png). Home's "From the supervisor · 6 more" lists the same ask again and again. The live `supervisor.for_owner` holds 9 lines, and 5 of them are the supervisor's "My engine needs `SPAWN_WORKSPACE` set, or a restart, so I can answer messages #1709, …". It said that at 00:51, 00:52, 04:02, 04:48 and 08:57, each time with a longer list of messages. Beside them are asks that the supervisor's newest block (08:57) no longer makes: the 00:51 "If the RSI resident stays idle on task 271, restart it or reassign the task" and the 04:02 note about worker 272's model. One line of the newest block, "Scenario 070 exits 2 on the base (look at its log in the gate output for task 280). Deploying the controller at or after cafc8ec … clears it", showed as current at 09:45, when task 280 had landed and 04dba790 was live. Nothing on the card says so: Home's rows carry a line and its age, not what became of the task it names. 064's `settled` hides only a review ask whose tasks have all ended, on purpose, since hiding a live ask is the worse failure. That stays.

Required behaviour.
(a) Every `for_owner` item carries `current`: true for the items of the supervisor's newest turn that has a For-the-owner line (inline, or a heading's list items as 070 reads them), false for the items of every earlier turn. A later turn without a For-the-owner line changes nothing. A turn is the turn, not a time: two turns are told apart even when their times are close.
(b) web/src/home.ts `latestNotes(attention, now)` shows only current lines that are not settled (and fresh, as today); `more` counts the other current, unsettled lines; a new `earlier` counts the unsettled lines of earlier turns, which are neither shown nor in `more`. The card says how many earlier lines there are and links to the full list.
(c) Each row `latestNotes` shows carries `taskStates`: what became of the tasks it names, worded as `allNotes` words its `tasks` ("T3 accepted", "T2 accepted, T4 cancelled"; "" when it names none). The card shows it beside the line.
(d) `allNotes` still lists every line, newest first, each row with `current`; the full list marks an earlier line as earlier.
(e) home.ts keeps loading with node alone.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/078.sh. A real `spawn loop` runs with the supervisor on, `spawn serve` answers, and a fake engine writes each turn's words to its transcript. Tasks 2 and 3 are accepted, 4 cancelled and 5 reported. The supervisor writes three turns:
- one: a heading over three items: the SPAWN_WORKSPACE ask for messages #11 and #12, "If task 5 stays idle, restart it or reassign it.", and "The relay names another model for worker 5.";
- two: a heading over two items: the SPAWN_WORKSPACE ask for messages #11, #12 and #13, and "Scenario bb.sh exits 2 on the base (see the gate output for task 3). Deploying the controller clears it.";
- three: "Next: check the gate logs." with no For-the-owner line.
Checks:
- (1) through `GET /api/attention`: turn two's two items are current, turn one's three are not, and the task-3 line keeps {tasks [T3 accepted], settled false};
- (2) under node, latestNotes shows turn two's two lines, with more 0 and earlier 3;
- (3) the shown task-3 line's `taskStates` is "T3 accepted", and the SPAWN_WORKSPACE line's is "";
- (4) allNotes has five rows, two current and three not.
It fails with 1 on 04dba790: items carry no `current`, latestNotes has no `earlier`, and its rows have no `taskStates`.

The product reason. Home is the first thing the owner reads, and its two supervisor lines should be what the supervisor asks now. An ask the supervisor has dropped, or one repeated five times, pushes a real ask out of view and teaches the owner to skim past the card. The supervisor restates its list in each For-the-owner block, so its newest block is the current one. A line whose task has landed since it was said stays visible but says so, without guessing from its prose that it is resolved.

This replaces backlog S27 (collapse repeated asks).

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (064 and 070 among them) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour: an attention.rs unit test for `current` across turns (a later turn with no For-the-owner line included), and web/test tests for latestNotes' `earlier`, its rows' `taskStates` and allNotes' `current`.
